justification: Changes which DCP rows the page marks as corner-only, which setback rows the yield box uses for a lot, and the page check that audits both

falsifiable_check.fails_when: a rule for non-corner lots ('all lots excluding corner lots', 'applies to non-corner lots') is marked corner-only, or a corner-only rule ('Other than garages, corner lots must...', 'not applicable to non-corner lots', 'exclude non-corner lots') is not
falsifiable_check.observed_red: On origin/main corner-status.ts has no exclusion test at all, so isCornerOnlyRow('all lots excluding corner lots') = true and the page tells a non-corner lot that a rule which applies to it does not. services/constraint_arithmetic.py on origin/main: 'Other than garages, corner lots must have a 3 m setback' matches _EXCLUDES_CORNER (True), and 'applies to non-corner lots', 'exclude non-corner lots', 'not applicable to non-corner lots' are all read as plain corner cases (measured by exec of the origin/main regexes 2026-10-20). The new tests in the three test files fail against those regexes.
